From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj@finstartup.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps + 30-min demo options — FintechCo

Hi Emma (and Raj),

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — really appreciated the context on your payments latency challenge and the throughput requirements for your reconciliation pipeline. Quick recap from our discovery call: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-transaction inference latency and cut inference cost for nightly reconciliation jobs.
- Current constraints: 10k TPS peak prep, sensitive PII fields, strict retention/audit needs.
- Success metric you mentioned: end-to-end mean latency < 150ms for lookup calls; predictable monthly inference spend.

As discussed, next best step is a short 30-minute demo for your engineering and infra leads (overview + how we'd approach a pilot). Proposed slots (all PT):

Option A: Tue 17 Mar, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — Recommended for infra/ops folks
Option B: Tue 17 Mar, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — Good for product + engineering
Option C: Wed 18 Mar, 2:00–2:30 PM PT — If you'd like both engineering + security/ops present

Please let me know which option works best or share a few times that fit your team. For the demo, would you expect your security lead to join, or should we keep it to engineering + product?

I've attached a short demo deck and a one-page proposed agenda for the 30-min session. If you prefer, Marcus (our solutions engineer) can do a 20–25 minute tech deep dive after the overview — I can include him on the invite once we lock the slot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf; proposed-multi-stakeholder-agenda.docx
